title: Police Incidents
description:
This dataset is published by the City of Dallas for research purposes only. The authoritative source for crime data is the Crime Analytics Dashboard.

This dataset represents the Dallas Police Public Data - RMS Incidents beginning June 1, 2014 to current-date. The Dallas Police Department strives to collect and disseminate police report information in a timely, accurate manner. This information
